title: Postharvest Drying and Curing Affect Cannabinoid Contents and Microbial Levels in Industrial Hemp (Cannabis sativa L.)
authors: Research authors as indexed in PubMed
notes: Supports drying/curing tradeoffs in studied hemp cultivars including time, moisture, decarboxylation, color and microbial outcomes. Do not universalize the tested temperatures or methods to all cannabis products.
